bias.en: Bearish · oversold, testing the $290 March low
bias.zh: 看空 · 超卖，测试 3 月 $290 低点

read.en: Broadcom fell 10.4% on Nov 5 to $291.53, trading $290.13–314.00 on 2.5 times its 20-day average volume. It is below the falling 5-day ($319.49), 10-day ($328.74), 30-day ($343.09), 100-day ($368.07) and 200-day ($367.25). MACD has been below its signal since Nov 2, below zero, with the histogram widening sharply; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 30 ($349.83), and RSI is 31.
read.zh: 博通 11月5日下跌 10.4%，收于 $291.53，盘中区间 $290.13–314.00，成交量为 20 日均量的 2.5 倍。股价位于下行的 5 日（$319.49）、10 日（$328.74）、30 日（$343.09）、100 日（$368.07）和 200 日均线（$367.25）下方。MACD 自 11月2日起位于信号线下方，处于零轴下方，柱状图明显扩大；抛物线 SAR 自 10月30日起看空（$349.83），RSI 为 31。

read.en: The gap lower broke the $319.3–321.9 and $314.1–316.3 supports, now resistance, and the low stopped just above the $289.96 Mar 30 low, the 52-week low. Resistance is $300, then $314–316.3 (Nov 5 high, Jan–Feb lows) and $319.3–321.9 (5-day, Oct 30 low). Support is $290 (Mar 30 and Nov 5 lows), then $281.6–281.9 (Aug 2025 lows). A close above $300 would target $314–316; below $290, $282.

r.en: Nov 5 high $314.0; Jan 23 low $314.1; Feb 17 low $316.3, lost
